example.en: Every one of them carried a bamboo basket in her hands.
She could even look after her four-year-old little brother.

simp.text: 有一年冬天，天冷得连水缸都结了冰。

trad.text: 有一年冬天，天冷得連水缸都結了冰。
trad.bpmf: 有一󠇢年冬天，天冷得󠇡連水缸都結了冰。

example.en: One winter it turned so cold that even the water jar froze over.

simp.text: 这么冷的天，哪里还有青草呢？

trad.text: 這麼冷的天，哪裡還有青草呢？
trad.bpmf: 這麼冷的天，哪裡還有青草呢？

example.en: On a day this cold, where would there be any green grass?

simp.text: 溪边开满红花，长满嫩草。

trad.text: 溪邊開滿紅花，長滿嫩草。
trad.bpmf: 溪邊開滿紅花，長󠇡滿嫩草。

example.en: Red flowers bloomed all along the stream and tender grass covered the banks.

simp.text: 叶子绿油油的，比巴掌还大。

trad.text: 葉子綠油油的，比巴掌還大。
trad.bpmf: 葉子󠇡綠油油的，比巴掌還大。

example.en: The leaves were a glossy green, bigger than the palm of a hand.

simp.text: 忽然那只白脖子的小鸟又从树后飞了出来。

trad.text: 忽然那隻白脖子的小鳥又從樹後飛了出來。
trad.bpmf: 忽然那隻白脖子󠇡的小鳥又從樹後飛了出來。

example.en: All at once the little white-necked bird flew back out from behind the tree.

simp.text: 一条弯弯曲曲的小溪哗啦哗啦地流著。

trad.text: 一條彎彎曲曲的小溪嘩啦嘩啦地流著。
trad.bpmf: 一󠇢條彎彎曲󠇡曲󠇡的小溪嘩󠇡啦嘩󠇡啦地󠇡流著。

example.en: A winding little stream went splashing and gurgling along.
She also packed two bags of mulberry seeds.

simp.text: 只看见沟口立著一棵老松树。

trad.text: 只看見溝口立著一棵老松樹。
trad.bpmf: 只看見溝口立著一󠇢棵老松樹。

example.en: All she could see was an old pine tree standing at the mouth of the ravine.

simp.text: 一边采叶子，一边轻轻地唱歌。

trad.text: 一邊採葉子，一邊輕輕地唱歌。
trad.bpmf: 一󠇢邊採葉子󠇡，一󠇢邊輕輕地󠇡唱歌。

example.en: They picked leaves and sang softly at the same time.

simp.text: 半山腰上排著一整排白色的屋子。

trad.text: 半山腰上排著一整排白色的屋子。
trad.bpmf: 半山腰上排著一󠇢整排白色的屋子󠇡。

example.en: A whole row of white houses stood along the hillside.

simp.text: 后母把一个空的竹篮子塞到阿巧手里。

trad.text: 後母把一個空的竹籃子塞到阿巧手裡。
trad.bpmf: 後母把一󠇡個󠇡空的竹籃子󠇡塞到阿巧手裡。

example.en: The stepmother pushed an empty bamboo basket into Ah Qiao's hands.

simp.text: 杭州里佛桥地方有一个聪明能干的小姑娘。

trad.text: 杭州里佛橋地方有一個聰明能幹的小姑娘。
trad.bpmf: 杭州里佛橋地方有一󠇡個󠇡聰明能幹的小姑娘。

example.en: In a place called Lifo Bridge in Hangzhou there lived a clever, capable little girl.

simp.text: 看见一只白脖子的小鸟，拍著翅膀往山沟里飞。

trad.text: 看見一隻白脖子的小鳥，拍著翅膀往山溝裡飛。
trad.bpmf: 看見一󠇢隻白脖子󠇡的小鳥，拍著翅膀往山溝裡飛。

example.en: She saw a little white-necked bird beating its wings and flying toward the ravine.

vocab.en: silkworm: the small white caterpillar that eats mulberry leaves and spins silk thread, the source of all silk

simp.text: 这种会吐丝的小虫有了自己的名字，叫做「蚕」。

trad.text: 這種會吐絲的小蟲有了自己的名字，叫做「蠶」。
trad.bpmf: 這種會吐絲的小蟲有了自己的名字󠇡，叫做「蠶」。

example.en: This silk-spinning little creature was given a name of its own, and it was called the silkworm.

vocab.en: heaven worm: the name the white-robed aunties give the silkworm, because they believe it comes from the sky

example.en: This snow-white little creature is called the heaven worm.

vocab.en: mulberry leaves: the only leaves silkworms will eat

example.en: The leaves we feed the heaven worms are called mulberry leaves.

simp.text: 把小茧抽成亮晶晶的丝线。

trad.text: 把小繭抽成亮晶晶的絲線。
trad.bpmf: 把小繭抽成亮晶晶的絲線。

example.en: She drew the little cocoons out into glittering silk thread.

vocab.en: the Silkworm Flower Goddess: the folk goddess who looks after silkworms and a good silk harvest

simp.text: 那位白衣姑姑，就是专门掌管蚕宝宝的「蚕花娘娘」。

trad.text: 那位白衣姑姑，就是專門掌管蠶寶寶的「蠶花娘娘」。
trad.bpmf: 那位白衣姑姑，就是專門掌管蠶寶寶的「蠶花娘娘」。

example.en: That white-robed auntie was the Silkworm Flower Goddess, who watches over the silkworms.

simp.text: 她眼前出现了一个像仙境一样美丽的村子。

trad.text: 她眼前出現了一個像仙境一樣美麗的村子。
trad.bpmf: 她眼前出現了一󠇡個󠇡像仙境一󠇡樣美麗的村子󠇡。

example.en: Before her eyes appeared a village as beautiful as a fairyland.

simp.text: 都跑来看她，说她一定是遇上神仙了。

trad.text: 都跑來看她，說她一定是遇上神仙了。
trad.bpmf: 都跑來看她，說她一󠇡定是遇上神仙了。

example.en: They all came running to see her, saying she must have met an immortal.

simp.text: 她赶紧擦干眼泪，跟著小鸟追。

trad.text: 她趕緊擦乾眼淚，跟著小鳥追。
trad.bpmf: 她趕緊擦乾眼淚，跟著小鳥追。

example.en: She quickly wiped her tears dry and hurried after the little bird.

simp.text: 阿巧被眼前的景色深深吸引，决定留下来。

trad.text: 阿巧被眼前的景色深深吸引，決定留下來。
trad.bpmf: 阿巧被眼前的景色深深吸引，決定留下來。

example.en: Ah Qiao was so taken with the scene before her that she decided to stay.

simp.text: 我们这里难得来客人，进来住几天吧！

trad.text: 我們這裡難得來客人，進來住幾天吧！
trad.bpmf: 我們這裡難得來客人，進來住幾天吧！

example.en: We rarely get visitors here, so come in and stay a few days!

vocab.en: to freeze in surprise, to be stunned

simp.text: 没想到一进家门，阿巧愣住了。

trad.text: 沒想到一進家門，阿巧愣住了。
trad.bpmf: 沒想到一󠇡進家門，阿巧愣住了。

example.en: The moment she stepped through the door, Ah Qiao froze.

simp.text: 弟弟也长成了个健壮的年轻人。

trad.text: 弟弟也長成了個健壯的年輕人。
trad.bpmf: 弟弟也長󠇡成了個󠇡健壯的年輕人。

example.en: Her little brother had grown into a strong young man.

simp.text: 这些五颜六色的丝线，是要送到天上。

trad.text: 這些五顏六色的絲線，是要送到天上。
trad.bpmf: 這些五顏六色的絲線，是要送到天上。

example.en: These silk threads in every color were to be sent up to heaven.

vocab.en: without realizing it, before you know it

simp.text: 越走越远，不知不觉，竟走到了小溪的尽头。

trad.text: 越走越遠，不知不覺，竟走到了小溪的盡頭。
trad.bpmf: 越走越遠，不知不覺，竟走到了小溪的盡頭。

example.en: She walked farther and farther and, before she knew it, reached the end of the stream.

vocab.en: from beginning to end, the whole story

simp.text: 她把上山、遇见白衣姑姑的事，从头到尾说了出来。

trad.text: 她把上山、遇見白衣姑姑的事，從頭到尾說了出來。
trad.bpmf: 她把上山、遇見白衣姑姑的事，從頭到尾說了出來。

example.en: She told the whole story of going up the mountain and meeting the white-robed aunties.
